purpose: Underlying filing and coordinate model for repository records. Public navigation is owned by manifest.json and begins at POTATO OF LIFE. This spine is an internal classification coordinate used by indexes and validators; it is not the public homepage tree.

public_navigation.rule: Do not derive the public root from repository_root taxonomy fields.

root_order.label: SPIRIT / MEANING
root_order.meaning: Source, meaning, belief and mythic or religious structures, with epistemic status preserved separately.

root_order.label: MIND
root_order.meaning: Psychology, comparative consciousness frameworks and neurobiology or embodied-cognition research.

root_order.label: MATTER / OBSERVABLE WORLD
root_order.meaning: Observable people, places, institutions, networks, objects, events, records and material systems.

spirit_layers.label: SOURCE
spirit_layers.meaning: Origin, creation, Father/source-side and other source concepts.

spirit_layers.label: MEANING
spirit_layers.meaning: Ideas, symbols, principles, visions, philosophy and interpretation.

spirit_layers.label: BELIEF / FAITH
spirit_layers.meaning: Religions, theology, doctrines, traditions and spiritual self-description.

spirit_layers.label: MYTHS
spirit_layers.meaning: Myths, sacred stories, mythological figures, creative lore, narratives and cosmologies.

mind_layers.label: PSYCHOLOGY
mind_layers.meaning: Behaviour, development, personality, cognition and inner-life models.

mind_layers.label: HAWKINSCALE
mind_layers.meaning: The project's comparative consciousness/emotion framework with explicit evidence boundaries.

mind_layers.label: NEUROBIOLOGY
mind_layers.meaning: Brain, nervous system, physiology and embodied-cognition research.

matter_layers.label: WORLDS & DOMAINS
matter_layers.meaning: Broad environments, fields, civilizations and domains of activity.

matter_layers.label: INSTITUTIONS & STRUCTURES
matter_layers.meaning: Durable organizations, authorities, infrastructures and coordinating structures.

matter_layers.label: NETWORKS & GROUPS
matter_layers.meaning: Connected populations, communities, markets, alliances and movements.

matter_layers.label: PEOPLE & LIVING ACTORS
matter_layers.meaning: Persons, populations and other living participants.

matter_layers.label: EVENTS & ACTIONS
matter_layers.meaning: Things that happen, change, move or are done.

matter_layers.label: RECORDS & SIGNALS
matter_layers.meaning: Texts, measurements, documents, datasets and other observable traces.

matter_layers.label: GROUND / GRAIN / DUST
matter_layers.meaning: Smallest concrete trace or material unit relevant to an investigation.

principle: The public archive is relationship-first and manifest-driven. The internal spine gives each record a coarse primary classification while scale, domain, time, epistemic status and graph relationships remain independent coordinates.
epistemic_rule: Spirit, Mind and Matter are filing coordinates, not ranks of truth or metaphysical certainty. Project canon, self-description, documentary evidence, historical evidence, science, comparison, interpretation, inference, creative lore, disputed claims and unknowns remain independently labeled.
potatoism_rule: Potato of Life / Potatoism material may primarily classify under Spirit/Meaning or Spirit/Belief while remaining reachable publicly through TIM, SON, SPIRIT, TRANSFORMATION, COSMOLOGY, TRADITIONS, CHRONOLOGY, SOURCES and other manifest branches according to relationship.
mind_rule: Psychological or neurobiological material should classify under Mind when the record's substantive subject is psychology, Hawkins-scale comparison or neurobiology, even if it is discussed inside Potatoverse material.
matter_rule: Observable geopolitical, country, institutional, economic, infrastructural and documentary records classify under Matter while their symbolic interpretations remain separate related records or epistemic layers.
placement_rule: Give each record one primary internal repository_root/repository_layer placement. Use graph edges, context clusters and manifest branches for cross-navigation rather than duplicating substantive records.
door_rule: Door is a concept and transformation relation, not an internal filing root.
axis_rule: Axis is a formal/symbolic concept and may appear in COSMOLOGY and NORTH. It is no longer a public root or an internal repository_root value.
world_rule: WORLD is a public manifest branch. It is broader than the internal Matter/world layer and may include proposals, analytical frameworks and contextual records linked to observable systems.

independent_coordinates.scale: Canonical material granularity from Worlds & Domains through Ground / Grain / Dust, primarily for Matter records.
independent_coordinates.domain: Religion, mythology, geography, politics, economy, science, technology, culture, security and other domains can occur at every root and scale.
independent_coordinates.time: Past, present and future can occur at every root and scale.
independent_coordinates.epistemic_status: Project canon, self-description, documentary, historical, scientific, comparative, interpretation, creative lore, inference, disputed and unknown remain explicit.
independent_coordinates.graph: Relationships may connect any records across Spirit, Mind and Matter; the graph is not subordinate to the filing tree.
independent_coordinates.context: Context clusters can join records from multiple internal roots and public branches without changing canonical ownership.
independent_coordinates.33_level_axis: Project-defined vertical framework remains a deeper symbolic/formal coordinate rather than the repository root.

legacy_navigation_mapping.axis: Retired public branch. Its former spiritual, symbolic and psychological contents are now distributed through manifest branches and Spirit/Mind internal classification.
legacy_navigation_mapping.world: Retired as one of only two public roots. Its observable-system material remains under the current WORLD branch and Matter internal classification.

non_goals: Do not expose Spirit, Mind and Matter as mandatory top-level public navigation.
Do not recreate AXIS / WORLD as the public root.
Do not treat internal classification as hierarchy of truth, value or spiritual rank.
Do not flatten graph relationships or context clusters into one tree.
Do not duplicate records solely to satisfy navigation.
